metadata.artifact: Domain: Principal::Agent, agent_account() naming, CiReader-equal grants, AgentRecord index type

acceptance: agent_account(project, env, machine) == '{project}-{env}-agent-{machine}', machine sanitized to [a-z0-9-] and at most 32 characters
Principal::Agent grants equal CiReader's: read only, boundary vaults only
AgentRecord serializes with no value or digest field

metadata.artifact: Causes and codes: agent_identity_not_installed, agent_identity_exists, agent_rejected, agent_store_unavailable, agent_store_locked, agent_store_volatile

acceptance: Each code has a category, exit code, retry, human_required and a typed next with actor person
No next suggests OPV_IDENTITY=person; a person-only refusal says to run the command in your own terminal
A rejected service-account token under the agent identity is diagnosed as agent_rejected

metadata.artifact: Credential-store adapter: AgentCredentialSource trait, fake, OS-store source on the backends S1 chose, non-interactive 5-second reads

acceptance: The trait has resolve, describe and preflight; resolve returns a SecretValue registered with the scrubber
A read never prompts: a locked store or one that would prompt gives agent_store_locked within 5 s
No usable store gives agent_store_unavailable; there is no file fallback
A volatile backend is reported as volatile in describe()

CI matrix round-trips a fixed dummy (never a token) through the real store: macos-latest Keychain, windows-latest Credential Manager, ubuntu-latest Secret Service under dbus-run-session (plus a locked collection failing as agent_store_locked within 5 s), and the WSL interop path via Credential Manager on a WSL1 distro on windows-latest (Vampire/setup-wsl)
WSL store is Windows Credential Manager via interop (spike s1: fresh-process read present, 656 ms); S19 is dropped unless interop is off

metadata.artifact: Selection rules 1-3 resolved once per process; OpCredential::Agent; stop without fallback

acceptance: An env token wins (rule 1); OPV_IDENTITY=person gives the person (rule 2); OPV_IDENTITY=agent gives the agent identity (rule 3)
OPV_IDENTITY=agent with no identity for an environment stops with agent_identity_not_installed and never uses a person session
Resolved once, before the first op call; Host::detect() reports op_credential = Agent afterwards

metadata.artifact: Runner: token on captured calls (token_only) and on inherited op run (vet R1)

acceptance: Each captured op call under the agent identity carries OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN only in its own env and takes token_only
Inherited op run: OP_SESSION*, OP_CONNECT_* and OP_ACCOUNT removed, add_op_session skipped, OP_BIOMETRIC_UNLOCK_ENABLED=false and OP_CACHE=false, env not cleared
Non-op children never get the token

metadata.artifact: Refusal unification, sync refused under the agent, write-path matrix

acceptance: Every one of the 12 require_person callers refuses with own_session_required under the agent identity before any op write
opv_import_local and provision use the selected identity, not environment variables only
opv sync under the agent identity is refused before any call, and Next says your own terminal or CI's deploy job

metadata.artifact: --create --agent: Destination split, binding check, store, index, production --confirm, clap flags for create and rotate, person_only

acceptance: Create requests read_items on exactly the CiReader vaults, --expires-in 90d, no --can-create-vaults
The binding check (whoami account UUID, vault set) runs on every create; on a mismatch nothing is stored and the person is told to remove the account
A production-tier environment without --confirm <env> is refused before the prompt
Output matches design §7.2 and ends with Next: opv doctor --env <env>; no token in the output
--agent conflicts with --github, --target and --grant-receipt; refused under agent markers

metadata.artifact: --rotate --agent for one identity or all on the machine; #324 marker per identity

acceptance: Without an env it rotates every indexed identity on this machine; one Do: line names every old account
The old token is replaced only after the successor passes the token-scoped check
An interrupted rotation refuses that identity with secret_not_stored and --revoked, and goes on with the others
A production identity without --confirm is skipped with a note

metadata.artifact: Doctor op identity row: states, reach, expiry, rate limit, store states

agent_store_volatile and agent_store_locked are FAIL rows
opv doctor runs a dummy store/read/delete round-trip on the user's machine and reports the store state; never the token
